item.title: Become a contributor!
item.description: As my career has evolved over the past 10 years, I’ve come to appreciate the value of collaborative ideas and solutions more than ever.  From my early days in software development and QA, into helpdesk, administrator, and architect roles, I’ve seen the best results in every field when we’ve worked closely together to solve problems.  Today, it’s become more apparent than ever that mass collaboration is going to be the innovation model that carries us into the future.  New challenges pop up faster than they ever have, and I’m increasingly relying on others to help me solve these challenges, as they are relying on me.  As a result, I’ve felt the need to become more and more involved with technology and relationships as these have proven key to fostering our joint success.
